race.comment: JAGUAR PAW (1) returned from over a year off the scene and was having his first run for the Matthew Smith stable when a courageous second over 1200m at this track last start. Bred to want a bit of ground so this is a lovely second-up assignment. Has the upside and will be tough to resist. GRAVEL ROAD (5) settled back in the small field and failed to improve when fresh from a spell here recently. Capable of a much better run out to this distance. HIDDEN NEWS (6) led all the way to take out his maiden over 1300m at Newcastle last start. Capable of another cheeky run. MR BOHEMIAN (7) returns from a lay-off. Ran fifth in most recent trial at Beaumont (Newcastle). Each-way.
